common_ground.text: The program as designed was not sustainable: scalar agrees with artkor on that, and differs on whether closing it was the fix.
Reports submitted during the program are to be paid: zerodartz says all eligible ones will be, and reporters are asking when.

output.headline: ZCG closed its vulnerability bounty over report volume; most of the thread is reporters waiting for payouts
output.next: zerodartz says eligible bounties will be paid once the third-party review is finalized, with no date. FPF notes the Q4 coinholder grant call for proposals opens October 30.

stakes.decision: Payouts for the remaining reports (further Zebra, lightwalletd, Zaino, zcashd) once ZCG's third-party review is finalized; no date given.

unresolved.text: When will the remaining reporters (further Zebra, lightwalletd, Zaino, zcashd) be paid?
Will pre-launch reports, or high-quality duplicates, get any payout?
Will any redesigned or narrower bounty replace the closed one?

best_against.quote: For reports that are still pending remediation or have not yet been publicly disclosed, we cannot discuss eligibility, severity, payment expectations, timelines, or review status in this thread.

best_for.quote: It has now been more than three months, and we still haven't received a clear update on when the rewards will be assigned.

views.label: Pay what is owed and say when
views.one_line: Accepted reports should be paid, and reporters need a status and a timeline. Some also ask for recognition of pre-launch work and of high-quality duplicates.

best_against.quote: I know you people are still working on the bounty issues, but I think little update from the team will go a long way for us.

best_for.quote: A third-party reviewer has delivered the majority of the GHSA details to ZCG, but it hasn't been quite finalized yet. Payments will be made once everything has been finalized and collected.

views.label: Payouts follow program terms, in stages
views.one_line: Review runs in stages, Zebra first. Pending reports can't be discussed, duplicates go to the first actionable report, and all eligible bounties will be paid once finalized.

best_against.quote: All of this was placing a huge burden on the developers, and we would have simply stalled our main plans for updating the Zcash NU7 protocol.

best_for.quote: The way forward is to improve the disclosure channel and reduce noise with a strict ruleset, clear PoC requirements, better automated filter/triage criteria.

views.label: Keep a bounty, but redesign it
views.one_line: Closing loses a security channel. Keep rewarding disclosure and cut the noise: strict rules, clear PoC or testnet proof, better triage, or an established platform.

best_against.quote: It really turns a filtering problem into the loss of an invaluable security channel.

best_for.quote: Every report, even a flawed one, must be treated with care until it is understood. That work pulls scarce engineering and security attention away from remediation, audits, releases, and other user-protecting work.

views.label: Close the bounty, keep disclosure open
views.one_line: AI makes reports cheap, so duplicate and speculative ones swamp engineers. Close the bounty; responsible disclosure and audit work continue.

output.why_it_matters: Zcash no longer pays for new bug reports. Researchers who reported bugs while the bounty ran are still waiting on payouts, and the thread shows no payment date.
